Hymn 259: Hope of Israel
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: F Major
Composer: William Clayson
Lyricist/Text Author: Joseph L. Townsend
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 259 titled "Hope of Israel" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by William Clayson and the lyrics were written by Joseph L. Townsend.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
